Author: Ajay Bhanot

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 74
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6485 of 2023
Applicant :- Dr. Abhishek Yadav

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arun K. Singh Deshwal,Anil Kumar Dubey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.27-D of 2015 at Police Station-Kotwali, District-Gorakhpur under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468,
471, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C.
The applicant is in jail since 13.04.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 19.01.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Arun K. Singh Deshwal, learned counsel assisted by Shri Anil Kumar Dubey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1).
The institution was granted requisite permission by competent authorities to take admissions.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Writ Petition as regards the declaration of result is engaging the attention of this Court.
(3). The applicant has been enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 27-C of 2015 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6918 of 2023 by this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6918 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: (4). The applicant has explained his criminal history.
The applicant has been falsely nominated in a number of cases only to show the proficiency of the police investigators.
The said cases do not have any bearing on the instant bail application.
(5). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Dr. Abhishek Yadav be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Vandit  Dr. Abhishek Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24066588/
